message: Multiple request properties resolve to the same generated name "orgId" after camelCase normalization: header parameter "X-Org-Id" (SDK name "orgId"), requestBody property "org_id" (SDK name "org_id"). This causes broken generated code. Use x-fern-parameter-name on a parameter or x-fern-property-name on a requestBody property to disambiguate.
